descriptionHtml:
This plus-size satin maxi bridesmaid dress offers a blend of comfort and elegance. The empire waist design flatters every figure, while the soft satin fabric creates a smooth, luxurious look. Convenient side pockets add a practical touch, making it perfect for weddings and formal events where both style and functionality are key.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
